description: Frozen input/output pairs for the step 4B PR 5 extraction surface: the retention barrel contract, retainTopKPerRole selection (K, targets, untargeted, exclusions, overrides, reservation, ties, malformed carriers), computeBudgetFloor, the E2 target map and the E6 iGPU exclusion set. DB-free: every id, score and price is a literal.
timestamp_policy: No ambient clock is read while capturing: every id, score and price is an input literal, so the document is byte-stable on its baseline commit. String order is recorded by code unit; nothing here reads a locale.

provenance.origin: Captured from the PRE-MOVE implementation under src/recommendation/retention/ before any module moved into packages/recommendation-core. The committed document is the baseline: do not regenerate it from the extracted code, because a fixture produced by the implementation under test proves nothing.

scenarios.description: K=1 with three CPU candidates keeps only the best scorer per role
K=3 with every bucket at or below K: returned whole, reservation never consulted
K=5 cuts a bucket of eight GPUs to min(K, eligible_count)
A declared roleTargets switches the CPU bucket to price-band picks (K=2)
The same pool with roleTargets null keeps the pre-E2 top-(K-1) plus reservation rule
roleExclusions as an array drops cpu-b before ordering and the K cap
roleExclusions as a Set drops cpu-b and cpu-c
topKByRole { GPU: 1 } caps only the GPU bucket
topKByRole {} is a no-op
topKByRole null is a no-op
K=2 reserves the cheapest CPU even when it is the lowest scorer
K=1 fills the slot from the reservation alone
Equal scores fall to the canonical tie-break: variant NULL first
